info.name: Get negotiated rates for a procedure code

params.name: code
params.description: The procedure code (CPT or DRG) to look up.

params.name: region
params.description: US state abbreviation to scope rates to.

params.name: tier
params.description: Service tier, e.g. professional or facility.

params.name: site
params.description: Site of service, e.g. nonfac or fac.

items.docs: Returns payer-negotiated reimbursement rates for a single procedure code (CPT/DRG), optionally filtered by region, tier, site of service, and payer.

info.name: Get rate distribution for a procedure code

params.name: code
params.description: The procedure code (CPT or DRG) to look up.

params.name: region
params.description: US state abbreviation to scope the distribution to.

params.name: tier
params.description: Service tier, e.g. professional or facility.

params.name: site
params.description: Site of service, e.g. nonfac or fac.

params.name: weighting
params.description: Weighting method for the distribution, by ein or npi.

items.docs: Returns the percentile distribution (5th-95th) of negotiated rates for a single procedure code, filtered by region, tier, site of service, payer, and weighting method.
